_comment: TDD M4 read slice: GET /models is the unversioned alias of /v1/models (same OpenAI list, owned_by=router accepted). RED on baseline (Go only serves /v1/models).
name: m4_read_api_models_alias
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[[models]]
name = "m-b"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"

[[models]]
name = "m-c"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
